name: Galileo (GNSS)
tagline: Europe's civilian GNSS — ~30 sats, sub-metre positioning
description: Europe's civilian GNSS — 34 satellites have been launched (4 IOV + 30 FOC); 27 operational + 1 commissioning as of May 2026; constellation target is 30 at 23,222 km MEO in 3 orbital planes inclined 56°. First operational service 2016; full operational capability declaration pending ESA/EUSPA official announcement. Unlike GPS (military operator) and GLONASS (military operator), Galileo is managed by EUSPA, an EU civilian agency. Designed for sub-metre positioning with open + commercial + Public Regulated Service tiers. Search and Rescue payload integrated for emergency-beacon detection.
best_known_for: Europe's civilian GNSS — ~30 sats, sub-metre positioning
